preserveSays.line: 🛡️ A man, maybe 30s, with a missing fingertip catches you eyeing the bark plates — claw-scored, vine-laced. "...Want to actually SEE one?" They talk you through it — wide strips dried flat, laced overlapping like shingles, snug but not tight. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
📓 Journal: the man in his 60s, with a long braid taught the man in his 50s, with a shaved head Food Preservation.
You eat Dried meat and Trail mix (1400 kcal).
📓 Journal: the man in his 60s, with a long braid taught the woman in her 40s, with grey-streaked hair Food Preservation.
👂 Overheard — Nathan: "Good. I'll take the first rotation. Somebody has to."

Travel 2 tiles to grove.
— Nut trees —
Mast crunches underfoot — last season's nuts, sprouting or rotting. The trees don't waste anything.
You see smoke on the horizon. Emberhold — 10 people, 3 days in. fishing folk, by the look of it. They know 3 plants — 3 new to you. They've been here the whole time.
A cold snap. Breath smokes. The woods go quiet.
Fresh food keeps days, not weeks. Smoke it over a fire to make it last.
The Dried beans was off. Your stomach knots. (-5 health)
The Dried beans was off. Your stomach knots. (-5 health)

Jacob leans in, voice low. "Here's what we figured out about the creek went still, and your arm-hairs stood up. Get OUT of the water. When the crackling starts, step onto dry ground — the discharge cannot reach you there. On land it is just a long blind fish: slow, harmless, dinner. Never fight it standing in the creek."

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — the creek went still, and your arm-hairs stood up: Get OUT of the water. When the crackling starts, step onto dry ground — the discharge cannot reach you there. On land it is just a long blind fish: slow, harmless, dinner. Never fight it standing in the creek. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

📓 Journal: Counter: Get OUT of the water — When the crackling starts, step onto dry ground — the discharge cannot reach you there. On land it is just a long blind fish: slow, harmless, dinner. Never fight it standing in the creek.

🔥 The fire settles. Marcus has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The creek went still, and your arm-hairs stood up — I put it down today." "The water goes glass-still. A faint crackling, and the hairs on your arms lift." "The crackling fades. It slides backward into the black water, done spending itself — for now." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Lucas asks "Did it look at you? Before?" Manuel says quietly "Did it look at you? Before?" Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
"So we made it OFFICIAL! The PARTY SYSTEM! Up to THREE companions! Formal! Tracked! With a UI! The audience can see your party composition now! Very important for the betting markets!"
A cold snap. Breath smokes. The woods go quiet.
🍽️ Jacob weighs the day's basket against the pantry shelves and puts it down. "Enough. Carving bowls instead — we're down to the cracked ones."

🍽️ Lucas carries the day's surplus to the pantry door, thinks better of it, and turns back to the fire. "It'll only rot in there. We eat."
